patch_description:
This crossover keeps the stronger boundary-aware search from the current implementation while incorporating the tighter interior clipping and broader restart behavior of the inspiration implementation. The main improvement is computational: incident triangle areas are evaluated directly from the opposite edge of each incident triangle, avoiding repeated construction of full `(candidates, 13, 2)` point tensors during every coordinate update.

The search retains square corners so the hull has exactly unit area, tests boundary projections explicitly, uses active-triangle normals and nearest-neighbor repulsion, and applies deterministic pair repairs plus strict coordinate polishing. Faster local evaluations allow more deterministic restarts while remaining reproducible.
